WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as avg_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
),
station_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg_usage
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
)
SELECT 
  AVG(sa.station_avg_usage) as mean_bandwidth_usage,
  AVG(sa.station_avg_usage) - oa.avg_usage as avg_above_average
FROM station_avgs sa
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE sa.station_avg_usage > oa.avg_usage
